IC1: - Patient has provided written informed consent.
IC3: - Patient is a planned recipient of a living donor kidney transplant.
IC4: - Patient is a planned recipient of an ABO blood group-compatible kidney graft.
IC5: - Patient is a planned recipient of a kidney graft from a donor that is [NOT] not HLA (human leukocyte antigen)-identical.
IC6: - Patient is negative for DSA (donor-specific antibodies).
IC7: - WOCBP (women [AND] of child-bearing potential) must have a negative pregnancy test at inclusion.
IC8: - WOCBP must be using an adequate method of contraception to [NOT] avoid pregnancy throughout the study [AND] and for up to 12 weeks after the study in such a manner that the risk of pregnancy is minimized.
